title: Great candle.
text:
Great candle.. This candle comes in a wonderful box that makes it very giftable. The scent is very natural and does not have a chemical Back smell
That some candles can have. I love the balsam sent and just natural woodsy smells. It says a burns 35 hours but I think mine burn a little longer than that Which is nice. The scent in the room Last for a while while this is burning. And even comes in a nice jar.

product_metadata.title: HomeLights Luxury Scented Candle, Natural Soy Wax, Home Fragrance Decor Gift, Iris & Orange Blossom, Medium Jar
features: ★SIZE: 7.19oz/204g. Home Lights used non-metal wicks to ensure a higher quality color, scent and a burn lasting up to 35 hour.recommended in about 15 square meters of space
★FRAGRANCE PROFILE: Iris & Orange Blossom. The graceful iris build around blackcurrant, jasmine and patchouli burst into radiant femininity punctuated with a sweet gourmand note.
★ECO-FRIENDLY & 100% SOY WAX: Home Lights uses top quality 100% soy wax, the product as biodegradable and eco-friendly.
★HIGH QUALITY BURN SUGGESTION: Set candle on heat-resistant surface and avoid drafts; Keep burning for 2-4 hours to evenly melt the surface of the candle for better flavor and experience.

★CLASSIC PACKAGED FOR HOME DECOR& LUXURY GIFT: Home Lights silky coloured glass and a rosegold steel lid with our unique botanical add-ins and soothing fragrances makes the luxury gift for every purpose.
